title: Pure Warrior
summary: Yusei Fudo's 'Warrior' Synchro archetype unites Junk Warrior, Stardust Warrior, Satellite Warrior, Jet Warrior, Nitro Warrior, Road Warrior, Drill Warrior, and Stardust Charge Warrior—powered by Junk Speeder, Synchro Chase, and Synchro Overtake! Reveal Junk Warrior or Jet Warrior in your Extra Deck with Synchro Overtake to Special Summon Junk Synchron or Jet Synchron directly from your Deck, then pair it with Junk Converter or Doppelwarrior to Synchro Summon Level 5 Junk Speeder. Junk Speeder's effect Special Summons up to 4–5 'Synchron' Tuners with different Levels directly from your Deck, while Synchro Chase revives a Synchron or 'Warrior' Synchro from your GY and prevents your opponent from responding to any of your 'Warrior' Synchro Monsters' effect activations! Climb into Level 10 Stardust Warrior (which tributes itself to negate any Special Summon and floats into Jet/Road Warrior!) and Quick-Synchro on the opponent's turn into Level 10 Satellite Warrior to destroy their entire board!

allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Junk Synchron, Junk Converter, or Doppelwarrior.
allow.One for One: Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Jet Synchron from your Deck.
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Jet Synchron or Doppelwarrior to the GY.

main: Junk Synchron

Yusei's iconic Level 3 DARK Warrior Tuner: when Normal Summoned, targets 1 Level 2 or lower monster (Junk Converter, Doppelwarrior, or Speed Warrior!) in your GY and Special Summons it in Defense Position—immediately assembling Level 5 Junk Speeder or Junk Warrior!
Junk Converter

Core Level 2 EARTH Warrior non-Tuner: discards itself and 1 Tuner to add ANY 'Synchron' monster from your Deck to your hand; and if sent to the GY as Synchro Material, immediately revives 1 Tuner from your GY!
Doppelwarrior

Core Level 2 DARK Warrior non-Tuner: if a monster(s) is Special Summoned from your GY (by Junk Synchron, Junk Converter, or Synchro Chase!), Special Summons itself from your hand; and when sent to the GY as Synchro Material, Special Summons 2 Level 1 'Doppel Tokens' (Warrior/DARK/ATK 400/DEF 400)!
Jet Synchron

Level 1 FIRE Machine Tuner: named Tuner for Jet Warrior; if sent to the GY as Synchro Material, adds ANY 'Junk' monster (Junk Synchron or Junk Converter!) from your Deck to your hand; OR sends 1 card from your hand to the GY to revive itself!
Stardust Synchron
Level 4 LIGHT Machine Tuner: tributes 1 monster to Special Summon itself from your hand or GY, and searches 'Synchro Chase' or 'Stardust Illumination' (or is summoned from Deck by Junk Speeder!).
Revolution Synchron
Level 3 EARTH Machine Tuner: can be used from your HAND as Synchro Material for a Level 7 or 8 Synchro, and mills 1 card to revive itself as a Level 1 Tuner!
Assault Synchron
Level 2 DARK Machine Tuner: Special Summons itself from your hand for 700 LP to guarantee Level 5 Junk Speeder even through disruption.
Wheel Synchron
Level 5 LIGHT Machine Tuner summoned from your Deck by Junk Speeder: can be treated as a non-Tuner for a Synchro Summon, and grants an additional Normal Summon of a Level 4 or lower monster!
Rush Warrior

Level 2 WIND Warrior handtrap: during damage calculation when a 'Warrior' Synchro Monster you control battles, sends itself from your hand to the GY to DOUBLE your battling monster's ATK; and banishes itself from your GY to add 1 'Synchron' monster from your GY to your hand!
Tuning
Adds any 'Synchron' Tuner from your Deck to your hand and mills the top card of your Deck.
Synchro Overtake

Limited to 1 in TCG: reveals 1 Synchro Monster in your Extra Deck ('Junk Warrior' or 'Jet Warrior'!) to add or Special Summon 1 of the 'Synchron' Tuners listed on it ('Junk Synchron' or 'Jet Synchron'!) directly from your Deck or GY!
Synchro Chase

Signature Continuous Spell: whenever you Synchro Summon a 'Warrior', 'Synchron', or 'Stardust' Synchro Monster, targets 1 material used in your GY and Special Summons it in Defense Position; AND your opponent CANNOT activate cards or effects in response to the effect activations of your 'Warrior', 'Synchron', or 'Stardust' Synchro Monsters!
Scrap-Iron Signal

Counter Trap: when your opponent activates a monster effect while you control a Synchro Monster that lists a 'Warrior', 'Synchron', or 'Stardust' Synchro Monster as material (Stardust Warrior or Satellite Warrior!), negates the activation and Sets itself back face-down!
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Junk Synchron, Junk Converter, or Doppelwarrior.
One for One
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Jet Synchron from your Deck.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Jet Synchron or Doppelwarrior to the GY.
extra: Core Level 5 WIND Warrior Synchro (1 'Synchron' Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners): when Synchro Summoned, Special Summons as many 'Synchron' Tuners as possible with different Levels (Level 1 Jet, Level 2 Assault, Level 3 Junk/Revolution, Level 4 Stardust, Level 5 Wheel!) directly from your Deck; and doubles its original ATK (to 3600 ATK) when battling a monster!

Signature Level 10 WIND Warrior Synchro boss (1 Tuner Synchro Monster + 1+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters; 3000 ATK): during either player's turn, when your opponent would Special Summon a monster(s) (Quick Effect), tributes itself to negate the Special Summon and destroy it, then revives itself during the End Phase; if it leaves the field by an opponent's card, Special Summons any Level 8 or lower 'Warrior' Synchro Monster ('Road Warrior' or 'Jet Warrior'!) from your Extra Deck (treated as a Synchro Summon!)!

Signature Level 10 DARK Warrior Synchro boss (1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters; 2500 ATK): when Synchro Summoned, targets cards your opponent controls up to the number of Synchro Monsters in your GY (unrespondable under Synchro Chase!), destroys them, and gains 1000 ATK for each destroyed card; floats into up to 3 Level 8 or lower 'Warrior', 'Synchron', or 'Stardust' Synchros from your GY if destroyed!

Level 8 LIGHT Warrior Synchro boss (3000 ATK; cheated out when Stardust Warrior leaves the field!): once per turn Special Summons 1 Level 2 or lower Warrior or Machine monster directly from your Deck!

Yusei's iconic Level 5 DARK Warrior Synchro ('Junk Synchron' + 1+ non-Tuners; 2300 ATK): enables Synchro Overtake for Junk Synchron, and gains the combined ATK of all Level 2 or lower monsters you control when Synchro Summoned!

Level 5 FIRE Warrior Synchro ('Jet Synchron' + 1+ non-Tuners; 2100 ATK): enables Synchro Overtake for Jet Synchron; targets 1 card your opponent controls on Synchro Summon and returns it to the hand (unrespondable under Synchro Chase!); and tributes a Level 2 or lower monster to revive itself from your GY!

Level 6 WIND Warrior Synchro (1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners; 2000 ATK): draws 1 card when Synchro Summoned (unrespondable under Synchro Chase!) and can attack all Special Summoned monsters your opponent controls once each.
Level 8 Synchro that revives a Level 2 or lower Tuner on Summon and Quick-Synchros on the opponent's turn into Level 10 Satellite Warrior!
Level 9 Synchro: equips Equip Spells from GY/hand in End Phase and destroys a card on field when an Equip Card is equipped to a monster.
